ارتكنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَنَا (irtakanā) /ir.ta.ka.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
# اِرْتَكَنَّا (irtakannā) /ir.ta.kan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
# اِرْتَكِنَا (irtakinā) /ir.ta.ki.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
